---
name: Clock problem
about: Report a reproducible problem on the MM32 + ESP8285 board
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Your clock**
Confirm the MM32 + ESP8285 board if you can, or add a clear board photo if unsure. Is it running on batteries or an external supply? Was a programmer/debugger connected?

**Versions and settings**
Firmware versions or the filenames you installed, if known. Movement style (Sweep / Burst / Hold&Start), second hand battery saver (Off / Night parking / On) and timezone/daylight-saving choice.

**What happened**
What you pressed/saved, expected result, actual result, approximate time and whether it repeats.

**Hands and LEDs**
Where did the hands stop? Was red flashing alone, blue showing, or both flashing together? If both flashed, how many flashes were in each repeated group? For uneven seconds, did it follow a pause at 12, a daily update, Save, or the hands finishing their initial setting?

Do not attach passwords, tokens, full flash dumps or unredacted private captures.
